title: Active whisper model route has no regression coverage
reasoning: The route performs validation for unknown models, rejects models that are not downloaded, persists ClientConfig.whisper_model, and returns the updated model list, but there are no linked tests for this feature and repository search found no tests exercising /whisper/models/active. A regression here could silently allow an unavailable model to become active or fail to persist the selected model, breaking local transcription later.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI tests for successful activation, unknown model rejection, and not-downloaded rejection, mocking or isolating WhisperModelService filesystem state.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no tests, and existing config tests only cover PDF settings on /api/config rather than whisper model management.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create tests that call PUT /api/config/whisper/models/active with a known downloaded model and assert the response active_model and persisted ClientConfig.whisper_model, plus 400 cases for an unknown model and a known but missing model file.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level pytest coverage for set_active_whisper_model; no production code change is required for this finding.
